Maintenance strategy that triggered the work.
Urgency of work; rank 1 is the most urgent.
Impact rating shared by severity and criticality columns; rank 1 is the most severe.
Composite asset risk band; rank 1 is the most severe. Watch sits between Medium and Low.
Lifecycle statuses, unique per entity scope. category: open, active, done or cancelled.

Units with a dimension and a factor to the dimension's base unit (null where no fixed factor exists). CUR_* units take their currency from the row. Dimension parameter_type holds non-measurement parameter types until phase 2 moves them to the policy
ISO-4217 currencies enabled for the platform; minor_units is the number of decimal places.
Countries and their subdivisions (codes follow ISO 3166), with tax regime, default currency and time zone. Tenants add subdivisions they operate in.
Functional failure modes. Seeded with every observed mode; near-duplicates await the owner's merge decision.
PV module defect catalogue plus inspection finding types for other asset classes.
Technician competencies required by work and held by crews.
Event classifications, unique per domain scope.
Systems data originates from. Aliases record whether a value was demonstration, synthetic, illustrative or configured data.
Sustainability disclosure frameworks that ESG metrics map to.
Versioned emission factors. Tenant-governed: each tenant approves its own values; no platform defaults ship.
Observed spellings mapped to canonical reference codes.
Records derived and values changed by governed data corrections (schema/reference/corrections.json).
